caption: The drawing features a central object composed of three distinct parts. At the top is a statue of a human figure dressed in classical attire with a helmet and a golden-yellow draped garment, holding a spear or staff in the left hand. The statue stands atop a gray and white fluted column with a capital. The column is attached to a circular medallion at the base. The medallion has a golden-yellow decorative border and a grayish interior. Within the circle, there is a profile portrait of a bearded man facing left, and around the portrait is an inscription that includes the words "A. KARAMANLIS" and "1833." The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. The composition is centered, with the objects vertically aligned in the middle of the paper.
title: Souvenir Spoon
